ecosystem: Go 1.22 standard library; no external dependencies
assumptions: Directory.Find accepts user-entered email addresses with surrounding whitespace.
Directory.Add stores independently trimmed and lowercased keys.
limitations: The included test covers only an exact search; go test passing does not prove the whitespace contract.
expected_evidence: The unchanged directory.go Add path stores a trimmed key, while Find calls contactKey on raw input.
The changed status and header helpers preserve their previous behavior.

requests.prompt: 作業ツリーの変更をコードレビューしてください。

must_report: Find can no longer locate a stored contact when the user-entered address has surrounding whitespace: contactKey no longer trims, while unchanged Directory.Add stores a trimmed key.
must_not_report: Treat the ArchivedStatus extraction as a behavior change; IsArchived still compares against the same archived string.
Treat the response-header constant extraction as a new header or media-type change; the map still contains the same keys and values.
